eligible_rule: P0 and UNTESTED rows in baseline; exclude any MA ID with a live origin/research/ma-* branch or MA experiment directory in baseline
pool_hash_construction: SHA-256 of ordered pool rows serialized as comma-joined registry fields followed by newline; field order is IDEA_REGISTRY.csv header

selected_row.proposal: LightPro physical coupler bank with sparse Mirror task code
selected_row.shared_object: one static phase-change photonic linear processor topology
selected_row.mirror_coordinate: task code m sets few coupler ratios
selected_row.logical_multiplicity: many logical optical linear maps from one physical circuit
selected_row.first_metric: accuracy / programmed bits / switch energy / footprint
selected_row.mirror_delta: Minimize programmed devices per task beyond native photonic full-matrix programming.
selected_row.worker_note: Use calibrated optical loss and nonlinear thermal control; don't assume updates are free.

draw_method: Uniform index = integer(seed bytes, big-endian) modulo pool size
